description: Angular component for alarm details dialog, managing alarm display, acknowledgment, clearing, and reassigning actions.

classes.name: AlarmDetailsDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing alarm details in a dialog.

methods.name: loadAlarm
methods.description: Fetches alarm info from the server and updates the observable.

methods.name: loadAlarmFields
methods.description: Populates form fields with alarm data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog, returning whether the alarm was updated.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Acknowledges the alarm via service call and updates UI.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the alarm via service call and updates UI.

methods.name: onReassign
methods.description: Handles alarm reassignment, updating UI accordingly.
